tagline.en: A vision-language-action policy from Spirit AI, built on a Qwen3-VL backbone for robot manipulation.
tagline.zh: Spirit AI 推出的视觉-语言-动作策略,基于 Qwen3-VL 主干,面向机器人操作。

en: Spirit-VLA v1.5 is a vision-language-action policy from Spirit AI Robotics. It reads camera observations and a language instruction and predicts robot action sequences, built on a Qwen3-VL vision-language backbone.

In WorldFoundry the native inference architecture and preprocessing run in-tree, loading the official checkpoint alongside the Qwen3-VL backbone with remote code disabled. The released ALOHA checkpoint predicts a 60-step action chunk (1x60x14). Note the policy checkpoint is sizable — around 21.6 GB — so plan your hardware and download accordingly.
zh: Spirit-VLA v1.5 是 Spirit AI Robotics 推出的视觉-语言-动作策略。它读取相机观测与一条语言指令,预测机器人动作序列,构建在 Qwen3-VL 视觉-语言主干之上。
在 WorldFoundry 中,原生推理架构与预处理在进程内运行,加载官方 checkpoint 与 Qwen3-VL 主干,并关闭远程代码。发布的 ALOHA checkpoint 预测 60 步动作块(1x60x14)。请注意策略 checkpoint 体量较大——约 21.6 GB——需相应规划硬件与下载。

whenToUse.en: When you want a Qwen3-VL-backed manipulation policy and can host a large checkpoint — the released ALOHA checkpoint targets bimanual manipulation.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用一个以 Qwen3-VL 为底座的操作策略、并能承载较大 checkpoint 时——发布的 ALOHA checkpoint 面向双臂操作。

notFor.en: The policy checkpoint is large (around 21.6 GB) and it depends on the Qwen3-VL backbone, so budget the memory and download before you start.
notFor.zh: 策略 checkpoint 较大(约 21.6 GB),且依赖 Qwen3-VL 主干,开始前请预留显存与下载空间。
